stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.12 — Roux Subphase-completion Operator, Color-neutral Frame Quotient & Resolution-expanded Method-specific Null

preexecution_data_policy.step_1: Census every already-sealed repository JSON manifest for unique Roux RAW_ALG_CUBING_LINK official attempts before any fresh network acquisition.
preexecution_data_policy.step_2: Use previously unused sealed attempts only if provenance fields result_id, attempt_number, raw_setup, raw_alg and route source are present and the attempt is not duplicated in the R1.11 bank.
preexecution_data_policy.step_3: Only if the sealed repository census cannot yield at least 100 G2-admissible attempts may R1.12 acquire additional public reco.nz reconstruction pages and WCA linkage evidence.
preexecution_data_policy.fresh_data_if_needed: Freshly acquired public routes are DEVELOPMENT_AND_CALIBRATION_ONLY in R1.12; they do not become a fresh cognitive prevalence sample merely because they are newly downloaded.

forked_nonprimary_strata: FB endpoints that cannot be oriented by an exact first-block history under the G2 frame
primary_population.reason: With N total attempts, each LOO test has N-1 references; add-one p_min=1/((N-1)+1)=1/N, so p<=0.01 requires N>=100.

color_neutral_center_consistent_quotient.center_canonicalization: At every queried state, apply the unique physical whole-cube orientation that returns center pieces to the default center arrangement. If unique center canonicalization fails, the state is geometry-ineligible.
color_neutral_center_consistent_quotient.color_neutrality: After center canonicalization, enumerate all 24 ordered physical block frames (bottom face x adjacent side face). This permits any color-neutral first-block choice without permitting arbitrary center/color relabeling.
color_neutral_center_consistent_quotient.block_mask: A 1x2x3 block consists of the three side-face edges not incident to the frame top plus the two bottom-side corners, in full piece+orientation coordinates.
color_neutral_center_consistent_quotient.frame_inference: Within the frozen SB subphase span, search forward for the first move state at which exactly one unordered left/right block-axis has both opposite 1x2x3 blocks solved after center canonicalization. That first unique two-block state defines the physical axis; later states cannot choose another axis.
color_neutral_center_consistent_quotient.first_side_orientation: Orient the axis using FB history: at the ordinary FB endpoint exactly one of the axis's two blocks must be solved and the opposite block must not be solved. The solved block is first block; otherwise the route leaves the primary exact-FB stratum.

subphase_completion_operator.SB_span: The maximal contiguous sequence of nonempty annotated lines classified ROUX_SB beginning at the first ROUX_SB line and ending at the last consecutive ROUX_SB line before CMLL/LSE/another non-SB phase. SS, SP, flipped SP and SB labels remain visible as annotation-family metadata rather than being collapsed into a completion claim.
subphase_completion_operator.completion: The first move state inside the frozen SB span where the uniquely inferred center-consistent physical axis has both blocks solved. This state, not the first annotation line endpoint and not automatically the last line endpoint, is the completed-SB endpoint.
blocking_cases: multiple physical axes at the first completion state
FB history cannot uniquely orient first versus second block
first block not preserved at completion

phase_geometry.FB: Objective distance to exact first-block mask over the annotated ordinary-FB line; endpoint must acquire the first block and leave the opposite block incomplete.
phase_geometry.SB: Objective distance to the second-block mask over the full SB span up to first state-certified completion; first-block damage is an anchor channel.
phase_geometry.CMLL: All-corner distance to annotated CMLL endpoint up to top-face AUF within the locked center-consistent frame; both blocks are anchors.
phase_geometry.LSE: Distance of the six non-block edges to the LSE/final endpoint in the locked frame; both blocks are anchors.
phase_geometry.feature_amplitude: Recompute every feature from raw route states. No R1.11 feature amplitude or attempt statistic may be copied into G2.

null_foundry.architecture: Roux-only LOO local-tail and nested no-test-fold-leak architecture retained from R1.11, rebuilt on G2 features.
null_foundry.attempt_statistic: maximum -log10(add-one upper-tail p) over G2 features within one attempt
null_foundry.primary_familywise_reference: Roux-global attempt-statistic bank. Feature-count-bin familywise references remain diagnostics unless they independently have >=99 LOO references.
null_foundry.primary_resolution: For every LOO test attempt, global familywise reference_n>=99; equivalently total admitted attempt bank N>=100.

authority_logic.future_roux_scoring_authority: Only if G2 geometry gates, null engineering gates, and 1% finite-resolution gate all pass in a prospectively frozen execution. Otherwise HOLD.
